Name: Cush, the Benjamite
Summary: Cush the Benjamite is named in the title of Psalm 7, a psalm David sang concerning Cush's words against him — a distinct man from Cush the son of Ham.
KeyStory: David answers slander with an appeal to the righteous Judge, asking God to vindicate him if he is innocent and to stop the violence of his accuser.
LifeLesson: When falsely accused, David's example is to take the case to God rather than take revenge into one's own hands.
